answer: Proof of Useful Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to solve complex computational problems akin to cracking a walnut shell to validate blocks. Because they cannot forge these cryptographically secure hashes, attackers must dedicate massive hardware energy. Like the resilient juniper root anchoring soil, this cost-intensive barrier forces rational agents to prioritize honest participation over identity cloning, rendering the creation of infinite fake nodes economically ruinous.
